text:
Copia,
Durchlauchtigster Fürst!
gnädigster Fürst und Herr!
Euer Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht ermangle ich nicht
untertänigst anzuzeigen, daß Sr Majestät auf den
Vortrag Höchstdero Schreibens vom 21ten d. M.
zu befehlen geruhet haben, daß die Beantwor¬
tung desselben, wie Euer Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht
selbst zu erwarten schienen, biß zur Einkunfft des von
dem Etats Minister v. Voss erforderten Berichts aus¬
Ich verharre mit der
gesetzt bleiben solle.
tiefsten Ehrerbietung
Euer Hochfürstlichen Durchlaucht
Berlin
den 25ten Januar 1799.
(ad 1. Febr 1799)
untertänigster diener
Beyme

translation.en: Copy. Most Serene Prince! Most gracious Prince and Lord! I do not fail most humbly to report to Your Most Serene Highness that His Majesty, upon the presentation of Your Highness's letter of the 21st of this month, has been pleased to command that the answer to the same, as Your Most Serene Highness yourself seemed to expect, should be deferred until the arrival of the report required from the Minister of State v. Voss. I remain, with the deepest reverence, Your Most Serene Highness's Berlin, the 25th of January 1799. (ad 1. Febr 1799) most humble and obedient servant Beyme

text_english: Copy. Most Serene Prince! Most gracious Prince and Lord! I do not fail most humbly to report to Your Most Serene Highness that His Majesty, upon the presentation of Your Highness's letter of the 21st of this month, has been pleased to command that the answer to the same, as Your Most Serene Highness yourself seemed to expect, should be deferred until the arrival of the report required from the Minister of State v. Voss. I remain, with the deepest reverence, Your Most Serene Highness's Berlin, the 25th of January 1799. (ad 1. Febr 1799) most humble and obedient servant Beyme
summary_en: Beyme reports, in a copy, that His Majesty, on being presented with the Prince's letter of the 21st of the month, has ordered that the reply be postponed — as the Prince himself had anticipated — until the report demanded from Minister of State v. Voss arrives. A brief court communication in the most deferential terms, noted as received 1 February 1799, conveying only this deferral and no substantive decision.
summary_de: Abschrift einer Antwort des Kabinettsrats Beyme: Auf die Vorlegung des fürstlichen Schreibens vom 21. dieses Monats habe Se. Majestät befohlen, die Beantwortung – wie der Fürst selbst erwartet zu haben scheine – bis zum Eingang des vom Staatsminister v. Voss eingeforderten Berichts auszusetzen. Beigefügt der Präsentationsvermerk "ad 1. Febr 1799". Sonst kein sachlicher Inhalt.
